inputs.checklistItemText: Adjacent driveways within 300 feet not shown on plans (DRV-04)
inputs.question: Are adjacent driveways on neighboring properties shown on this sheet? Look for driveways on adjacent properties along the street frontages. When identifying adjacent driveways, look for two wide, flat-bottomed U-shapes or J-shapes side by side with a gap between them.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/feature-identification question—whether adjacent driveways appear on the sheet at all—rather than measuring the 300-foot spacing between them. This is a progressive verification step (presence check before measurement); routing is based on the agent question, which is narrower than the full checklist requirement.
